summary_en: Shimizu raised interim dividend to 44.50 yen per share from 38.50 yen, and revised full-year dividend forecast to 89.00 yen from 77.00 yen, reflecting improved earnings outlook with operating profit upgraded 25.5% to 192.0 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Business Forecast and Revision (Dividend Increase) of Interim Dividend and Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
Shimizu Corporation revised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ended March 31, 2027, raising the interim dividend per share to 44.50 yen from the previously announced 38.50 yen, and revising the full-year dividend forecast to 89.00 yen per share from 77.00 yen. The interim dividend was determined based on earnings as of September 30, 2026, with an effective date of December 2, 2026, and total interim dividend amount of 29,974 million yen.

The dividend increase reflects a substantial upward revision of the company's earnings outlook. Operating profit for fiscal 2027 was increased by 39.0 billion yen (25.5%) to 192.0 billion yen, driven by improved profitability in domestic architectural and civil engineering projects. The company reported steady progress in construction execution, acquisition of change orders, and compression of construction costs. Operating margin on completed construction work is now forecast at 14.5%, compared to the previously estimated 12.7%, with architectural projects at 15.3% and civil engineering at 11.0%.

Net income attributable to parent company shareholders was revised upward by 20.5 billion yen (12.4%) to 186.0 billion yen, despite a 10.0 billion yen downward adjustment in investment securities gains due to declines in certain stock holdings. Earnings per share for the full year is now projected at 275.27 yen, compared to the prior forecast of 243.72 yen.
